mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates tight monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is continuously active as the rate level is observed.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rise above 4.5% within 3 months signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% within 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in CPI (above 0.2% in 3 months) and federal funds rate (above 0.1% in 3 months) signal aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% in 3 months AND FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS both rise by thresholds, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, GDP growth above 11400 (GDPC1) and housing starts above 1850 (HOUST) indicate overbought market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when GDPC1 > 11400 and HOUST > 1850, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic slowdown prompting Fed rate cuts, causing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 110 signals manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 110, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Employment growth below 0.5% (PAYEMS) combined with unemployment above 4.5% (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market and increased recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate below 3.0% combined with CPI below 2.0% signals accommodative monetary policy lowering equity discount rates, causing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.0% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
